attestation.risk_summary: The agent-council OpenClaw skill presents a low-to-moderate risk profile consistent with a legitimate multi-agent orchestration toolkit. All three Semgrep medium findings are false positives in context — standard urllib API calls to Discord's REST API — and the provenance flags (47-day account age, no lockfile) are non-compounding and expected in the young OpenClaw ecosystem. No encoded payloads, credential harvesting, silent persistence, or malicious instruction patterns were identified in the current version; residual risk is limited to standard supply chain hygiene concerns applicable to any network-capable open-source tool.
